svg.title: Pothole Reporter nationwide India coverage overview
svg.desc: India coverage map using a CC0 boundary from the DataMeet India community that includes disputed territories in accordance with the Survey of India boundary standard. All 28 states and 8 Union Territories have coordinate-pinned boundary containment and conservative official grievance handoffs. Mapped National Highways and existing exact city or authority routes retain precedence. The 50 available routes shown for population centres follow Census of India 2011 table A-04 (I). Eight markers use conservative structured city-name routes; these markers identify population centres and do not represent complete urban-agglomeration boundaries. Coverage does not prove road ownership, and nothing is submitted automatically. No government endorsement is implied.
svg.metadata: Boundary source: DataMeet India community, india-composite.geojson (CC0), commit 5ed214bf77788f99066e3542cccd4a52cb042896, input SHA-256 5e44c39b18aa8fe57267d8018fa4ad4a10eaa3aa4cb7cb7382a1813ef8eb8c53. Source: https://github.com/datameet/maps/blob/5ed214bf77788f99066e3542cccd4a52cb042896/Country/india-composite.geojson . The source states that it includes disputed territories in accordance with the official Survey of India boundary. Geometry was simplified to 0.025 degrees for this 320-pixel README display. Coverage shading and annotations: Pothole Reporter. No government endorsement is implied.
